declaration.preface:
PEWSPL is committed to promoting fair compensation practices, responsible employment conditions, and employee well-being across all its operations. The Company recognizes that fair wages, ethical employment practices, and respectful workplace conditions are essential for employee dignity, workforce stability, operational efficiency, and sustainable business growth.

PEWSPL strives to ensure that employees and workers are compensated fairly and in compliance with applicable labour laws, wage regulations, and statutory requirements. The Company is committed to maintaining transparent wage practices, timely payment processes, responsible working conditions, and employee welfare initiatives while fostering a respectful, inclusive, and ethical workplace culture.
declaration.declaration:
The purpose of this Policy is to promote fair, transparent, and responsible compensation practices across PEWSPL’s operations while supporting employee welfare, workplace dignity, and ethical employment standards.

Promote fair wage and compensation practices across all workforce categories.

Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws, wage regulations, and statutory obligations.

Support employee welfare, financial well-being, and responsible workplace practices.

Encourage transparent and equitable payroll and compensation processes.

Promote responsible working hours and lawful overtime compensation practices.

Foster employee trust, workplace stability, and ethical employment standards.

Strengthen awareness regarding employee rights, benefits, and workplace responsibilities.

Promote continual improvement in compensation management and employee welfare practices.
declaration.scope: This policy applies to all operations of PEWSPL, including transportation activities, operational facilities, warehouses, and office locations across all locations where PEWSPL operates. It covers all permanent, temporary, and contractual employees across all functions, as well as all internal and external stakeholders associated with PEWSPL, whether directly or indirectly engaged with the organization’s operations and services.

definitions.title: Living Wage Definition & Methodology
definitions.content:
PEWSPL strives to ensure that employees and workers are compensated fairly and in compliance with applicable labour laws, wage regulations, and statutory requirements.

We aim to ensure that employees and workers receive wages and benefits in compliance with applicable labour laws and statutory requirements.

We are committed to ensuring timely payment of wages, salaries, overtime compensation, reimbursements, and statutory benefits.

This policy applies to all operations of PEWSPL, including transportation activities, operational facilities, warehouses, and office locations across all locations where PEWSPL operates. It covers all permanent, temporary, and contractual employees across all functions, as well as all internal and external stakeholders associated with PEWSPL, whether directly or indirectly engaged with the organization’s operations and services.

The Company is committed to continually improving employee compensation and welfare practices through periodic review of wage structures, employee benefits, payroll processes, and compliance mechanisms. The Company will continue strengthening fair compensation practices and employee well-being initiatives in line with legal requirements, operational needs, and responsible business commitments.

This Living Wage Policy shall be reviewed annually by the Finance and Payroll Department, or whenever significant changes occur in labour laws, wage regulations, business operations, workforce requirements, or organizational practices, to ensure its continued relevance, effectiveness, and alignment with the Company’s fair compensation commitments.

Fair Compensation Practices: We are committed to maintaining fair, transparent, and responsible compensation practices across all operational locations.
We aim to ensure that employees and workers receive wages and benefits in compliance with applicable labour laws and statutory requirements.
We strive to periodically review wage structures and compensation practices to support employee welfare and responsible employment standards.
We are committed to promoting equitable and non-discriminatory compensation practices across the organization.
We seek to maintain responsible payroll administration and compensation management systems.
We strive to ensure transparency and consistency in compensation-related processes and practices.
Timely Wage and Salary Payment: We are committed to ensuring timely payment of wages, salaries, overtime compensation, reimbursements, and statutory benefits.
We aim to maintain accurate payroll processing and responsible wage administration practices.
We strive to strengthen payroll transparency and employee awareness regarding wage-related processes.
We are committed to complying with applicable statutory deduction, payment, and payroll-related legal requirements.
We seek to minimize payroll discrepancies and strengthen corrective action mechanisms wherever required.
Working Hours and Overtime Management: We are committed to complying with applicable labour laws relating to working hours, attendance, leave, and overtime practices.
We aim to maintain responsible workforce scheduling and attendance management practices across operations.
We strive to ensure lawful overtime compensation and prevent excessive working hours wherever operationally feasible.
We are committed to promoting responsible workplace practices that support employee well-being and operational efficiency.
We seek to maintain fair and transparent overtime management procedures across applicable operational functions.
Employee Welfare and Well-Being: We are committed to supporting employee welfare, dignity, and respectful workplace practices across all operations.
We aim to foster a positive and professional work environment that promotes employee well-being and workplace stability.
We strive to support employee welfare initiatives and responsible workplace practices wherever feasible.
We are committed to promoting ethical employment practices and fair treatment of employees and workers.
We seek to encourage work-life balance and responsible workplace interactions wherever operationally feasible.
Payroll Compliance and Transparency: We are committed to maintaining payroll processes that comply with applicable labour laws, wage regulations, and statutory obligations.
We aim to maintain accurate wage records, payroll documentation, and statutory compliance practices.
We strive to strengthen payroll confidentiality, transparency, and responsible compensation management systems.
We are committed to ensuring compliance with statutory benefits, deductions, and wage-related reporting requirements.
We seek to periodically review payroll and compensation management processes for continual improvement.
Equal Opportunity and Non-Discriminatory: We are committed to promoting equal opportunity and fair compensation practices across all workforce categories.
We aim to prevent compensation-related discrimination based on gender, background, religion, ethnicity, age, or other protected characteristics.
We strive to promote fair and responsible compensation decisions based on qualifications, responsibilities, skills, and performance.
We are committed to maintaining respectful, inclusive, and equitable workplace practices.
We seek to strengthen awareness regarding fair treatment and responsible workplace behaviour across the organization.
Employee Awareness and Communication: Promote employee awareness regarding compensation practices, benefits, payroll processes, and workplace support mechanisms.

We aim to maintain 100% timely payment of wages and salaries annually through FY 2029–30 from the baseline from FY 2022-23.
We strive to reduce payroll discrepancies by 90% by FY 2029–30 from the FY 2022–23 baseline.
We aim to strengthen payroll communication and employee support mechanisms across 100% of operational locations by FY 2029–30 from the baseline FY 2022-23.
We strive to improve employee awareness regarding payroll processes and salary-related communication to at least 85% by FY 2029–30 from the FY 2022–23 baseline.
We aim to maintain 100% compliance with applicable overtime payment and working hour requirements through FY 2029–30 from the baseline FY 2022-23.
We strive to improve attendance and workforce scheduling compliance practices by 85% by FY 2029–30 from the FY 2022–23 baseline.
We aim to strengthen monitoring of overtime and attendance-related compliance practices across 100% of major operational locations by FY 2029–30.

We aim to improve employee participation in workplace welfare and well-being initiatives to at least 80% by FY 2029–30 from the FY 2022–23 baseline.
We strive to strengthen communication regarding employee welfare initiatives across 100% of major operational locations by FY 2029–30.
We aim to conduct a minimum of 2 employee welfare and engagement initiatives annually through FY 2029–30.
We strive to improve employee awareness regarding welfare facilities, workplace support mechanisms, and employee well-being initiatives to at least 90% by FY 2029–30 from the FY 2022–23 baseline.
We aim to maintain 100% statutory payroll compliance across all applicable operational locations through FY 2029–30.
We strive to improve payroll documentation and record management practices across 100% of applicable departments by FY 2029–30.
We aim to improve payroll-related grievance resolution practices by 90% by FY 2029–30 from the FY 2022–23 baseline.

We aim to improve employee awareness regarding equal opportunity and fair compensation practices to at least 90% by FY 2029–30 from the FY 2022–23 baseline.
We strive to maintain zero confirmed cases of compensation-related discrimination annually through FY 2029–30.
We aim to strengthen communication regarding workplace equality and fair employment practices across 100% of departments by FY 2029–30.
We strive to improve employee participation in workplace equality and fair compensation awareness initiatives to at least 85% by FY 2029–30 from the FY 2022–23 baseline.

The Company will continue strengthening fair compensation practices and employee well-being initiatives in line with legal requirements, operational needs, and responsible business commitments.
